messages.task:
You are a financial-analysis assistant working on a synthetic corporate-report environment.  You have access to several callable tools that expose structured information extracted from the company’s filings and calculated helpers.  Use them as needed to obtain the requested numerical answer and reply with that number only (no explanation).

SCENARIO
A 2017 Form-10-K discusses intangible-asset amortisation and multiple goodwill impairment assessments.  The filing states that in the fourth quarter of 2016 the company tested all reporting units for impairment.  All units passed except the Surface Mining & Technology reporting unit within the Resource Industries segment.  For that unit the test indicated fair value was below carrying value, triggering the second-step goodwill impairment analysis.  As a consequence the company recorded a goodwill impairment charge, leaving a smaller goodwill balance as of 1 October 2016.

TOOLS AVAILABLE
• list_reporting_units_by_segment(segment_name:str) -> List[str]
  Return names of every reporting unit that belongs to the provided operating segment.

• get_segment_name_for_unit(unit_name:str) -> str
  Return the name of the operating segment to which a reporting unit belongs.

• get_impairment_event_dates(unit_name:str, only_positive:bool=False) -> List[str]
  List ISO-8601 dates on which a goodwill impairment event was recorded for a unit.  Set only_positive=True to see only events with a positive impairment charge.

• get_impairment_charge(unit_name:str, event_date:str) -> int
  Return the goodwill impairment charge (in millions of USD) for the given unit on the specified date.

• get_remaining_goodwill(unit_name:str, event_date:str) -> int
  Return the goodwill amount that remained (in millions of USD) after the impairment recorded on that date for the given unit.

• compute_pre_impairment_goodwill(impairment_charge_millions:int, remaining_goodwill_millions:int) -> int
  Pure helper: adds the impairment charge to the remaining goodwill to obtain the goodwill balance immediately before the impairment.

• get_total_impairment_for_unit(unit_name:str) -> int
  Return the cumulative impairment charges recognised across all events for a unit.

QUESTION
What was the pre-impairment goodwill, in millions of dollars, for the Surface Mining & Technology reporting unit as of 1 October 2016?

Provide only the number (no currency symbol, no commas, no text).
